key_workflows_and_components.name: Navigation & Step Indicator
key_workflows_and_components.purpose: Persistent top bar with brand mark, active project switcher, login/auth controls, and the 4-step workflow indicator (Site Validation → Design & Costing → AI Formulation → Summary/Export).
key_workflows_and_components.guidelines: Never transparent. Solid black #09090B with 1px border-b border-zinc-800. Data testids: nav-step-1, nav-step-2, nav-step-3, nav-step-4, nav-auth-btn.

key_workflows_and_components.name: Dashboard Overview
key_workflows_and_components.purpose: Overview of active modular housing projects, compliance audit readiness, pending environmental vetoes, data gap flags, and New Project initiator modal.
key_workflows_and_components.guidelines: Bento grid mode B (Data Density). Metric tiles, compliance status tags, and quick-launch pre-configured demo sites (e.g. 'Nordic Modular Quad', 'Harbor Eco-Terrace', 'Riverfront Veto Test').

key_workflows_and_components.name: Site Validation & GIS Engine
key_workflows_and_components.purpose: Interactive Leaflet map allowing polygon boundary drawing, geodesic area/perimeter calculation, flood-zone overlays (100-year & 500-year), and protected ecological land reserves.
key_workflows_and_components.guidelines: Immediate intersection detection: if polygon overlaps flood or ecological reserve, trigger a prominent red 'HARD VETO' banner with exact legal clause. If clear, display green 'SITE APPROVED' badge with max building footprint calculation.

key_workflows_and_components.name: Interactive Modular Design & Costing Canvas
key_workflows_and_components.purpose: Drag-and-drop 2D grid/isometric canvas to assemble modular housing blocks (Bedroom 18m², Kitchen 14m², Bathroom 8m², Living 24m², Solar Roof, Green Roof). Live materials database (Cross-Laminated Timber, Low-Carbon Geopolymer Concrete, Recycled Steel, Straw-Bale insulation) with unit costs, carbon coefficients (kg CO2e/m²), and comparison bar charts.
key_workflows_and_components.guidelines: Live recalculation bar at the top or docked right: Total Units, Gross Floor Area, Estimated CapEx, Carbon Footprint vs Traditional Benchmark, with instant material swapping selector.

key_workflows_and_components.name: AI Formulation Multi-Agent Engine
key_workflows_and_components.purpose: Sequential 6-agent simulation execution: THOT (Site & Zoning Context), KAEL (Regulatory Code & Citations), IRIS (Modular Generative Design), CRONOS (Budget & Cashflow Sequencing), TERRA (Logistics & Low-Carbon Suppliers), LYRA (Municipal Dossier & Final Documentation).
key_workflows_and_components.guidelines: Each agent possesses a dedicated terminal card showing status (Idle, Analyzing, Complete), streaming response log, confidence rating, and clickable 'DATA GAP FLAGGED' notice pills that expand resolution dialogues.

key_workflows_and_components.name: Local Sourcing Directory
key_workflows_and_components.purpose: Browsable directory grid of certified modular prefab builders, off-site timber fabricators, environmental engineering consultants, and circular material suppliers.
key_workflows_and_components.guidelines: Filter by radius (within 25km, 50km, 100km), material certification (FSC, Cradle-to-Cradle), and availability. Detail drawer with quote request action.

key_workflows_and_components.name: Project Summary & Export Dossier
key_workflows_and_components.purpose: Executive summary view consolidating site polygon metrics, compliance stamp, module breakdown, CapEx breakdown, carbon balance sheet, and a mock 'Download Municipal Dossier PDF' button.
key_workflows_and_components.guidelines: Printable layout stylesheet compatibility, cryptographic hash verification badge, and export download simulator with sonner feedback.

agents_specification.focus: Ingests GIS parcel boundaries, topography gradients, sunlight access, and density allowance under ISO 37120.
Verifies setback distances, fire egress codes, local timber construction caps (Eurocode 5 / IBC 2024), and flags flood-zone vetos.
Generates optimal stacking and clustering configurations for pre-engineered modules to maximize natural ventilation.
Calculates bill-of-quantities (BOQ), off-site crane assembly schedules, foundation vs factory modular costs.
Computes A1-A5 cradle-to-gate carbon coefficients, transport miles, and matches local certified timber/hemp suppliers.
Compiles executive summary, geo-coordinates, environmental declaration (EPD), and submission-ready packet.

accessibility_and_testing.mandatory_data_testid_rules: All buttons, tab items, inputs, switches, modals, metric badges, agent trigger buttons, and canvas elements MUST have explicit data-testid attributes.
accessibility_and_testing.color_contrast: White on #09090B exceeds 18:1 APCA. Status colors (Green #22C55E, Red #EF4444, Amber #F59E0B) have high contrast background tints with solid readable text.
accessibility_and_testing.keyboard_navigation: Interactive canvas modules and agent buttons must respond to Enter/Space.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow this exact monochrome architectural aesthetic: bold heavy sans-serif headings, sharp 1px borders, subtle 24px grid lines.
Use color STRICTLY for functional state indicators: Green for compliant/approved, Red for hard veto/conflict, Amber for data gap flags.
Include JWT auth mock/live state in the header navigation (with easy toggle or modal so all pages are accessible).
On Site Validation: support Leaflet drawing with interactive polygon tool or instant 1-click sample sites (Compliant site vs Flood-Zone Veto site).
On Interactive Design: allow adding/removing modules on grid canvas with immediate dynamic recalculation of total cost, embodied carbon, and floor area.
On AI Engine: simulate step-by-step agent execution with real architectural and regulatory citations (Eurocode 5, IBC 2024, EPD standard EN 15804).
Remember to include Sonner toast notifications and download simulation for municipal dossier PDF.
